scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api run dev
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/worker run dev
scripts.dev:workbench: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/workbench run dev
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.test:integration: node -e "console.error('[RESERVED] test:integration will be connected in Phase 1 (P1-02/P1-06).'); process.exit(1);"
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "console.error('[RESERVED] test:e2e will be connected in Phase 1 (P1-09).'); process.exit(1);"
